response.sql: WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown') AS hand FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count FROM winners GROUP BY hand) SELECT hand, winner_count, winner_count * 1.0 / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM hand_counts ORDER BY hand
